units.title: Simulation of Electronic Circuits Using Simulation Software
topics: 1.1. Introduction to different types of Circuit simulation software
1.2. Wire, bus, junction, probe, voltage source, current source, and ground etc. used in circuit simulation software.
1.3. Create new project, and schematic file.
1.4. Search, Add or Create an electronic part.
1.5. Edit, Connect, or wire the circuit.
uos: 1.a. State the features of different circuit simulation tools (Open source or free or licensed) used for electronic circuit simulation.
1.b. Define the general terms used in circuit simulation software.
1.c. Create new project, make schematic and save it.
1.d. Use 'Search', 'add' or 'create' an electronics component to the schematic file of the simulation software.
1.e. Design an electronics circuit using circuit simulation software.

units.title: Analyze Electronic Circuits Using Simulation Software
topics: 2.1. Test Passive components RC, LC or RLC based electronic circuit.
2.2. Test DC simulation of active components like diode, transistor or MOSFET based electronic circuit.
2.3. Test DC Simulation of analog/digital IC based electronic circuit.
2.4. Transient simulation of RC, LC, or RLC based electronic circuit.
2.5. Bias point analysis or characteristic curve of diode, transistor or MOSFET based electronic circuit.
2.6. Transient simulation of diode, transistor or MOSFET etc. based electronic circuit. Circuit Design & Tools Course Code: 4341104 software.
2.7. Frequency response (AC simulation) of RC, diode, and transistor etc. based electronic circuit.
2.8. Frequency response (AC simulation) analog/ digital IC based electronic circuit.
2.9. Install Circuit Simulation Android/IOS Application on your mobile and demonstrate it.
uos: 2.a. Simulate and test the passive components like RC, LC, or RLC based electronic circuit using circuit simulation software.
2.b. Simulate and test the active components like diode, transistor or MOSFET based electronic circuit using circuit simulation software.
2.c. Simulate and test the analog or digital IC based electronic circuit using circuit simulation software.
2.d. Find the transient analysis of RC, LC, or RLC based circuit using circuit simulation software.
2.e. Find the bias point analysis of diode, transistor or MOSFET based circuit using circuit simulation
2.f. Find the transient analysis of diode, transistor or MOSFET etc. based circuit using circuit simulation software.
2.g. Find the frequency response (AC simulation) of RC, diode, transistor etc. based electronic circuit using simulation software.
2.h. Find the frequency response (AC simulation) of analog/ digital IC based circuit using simulation software.
2.i. Find Circuit Design simulation Android/IOS application.

units.title: PCB Layout Design
topics: 3.1. Learn the basics terms of software & PCB layout - grid, top & bottom copper, pads, vias, netlists, silkscreen etc.
3.2. Download, install and configure PCB designing software. Get components library for chosen software.
3.3. Create a schematic of the chosen circuit & generate netlists from the created schematic.
3.4. Arrange components in a neat manner. Trace each net on appropriate layers and finish routing the board.
3.5. Check for any pending nets using tool. & Perform Design Rule Check (DRC) and Electrical Rule Check (ERC) of your board. Add copper pours, silkscreen, holes for mounting, etc.
3.6. Generate design files (Gerber files) & Bill of Materials (BOM). Preview your completed PCB design Circuit Design & Tools Course Code: 4341104 using the preview tool.
3.7. Make custom library components for various SMD & PTH Parts.
uos: 3.a. Learn basics of PCB terms net list, back annotation, bill of material, footprint, PTH, track width, mil, etc. used in PCB layout design software.
3.b. Transfer an electronic circuit to PCB layout design software.
3.c. Search, add and create footprint of different electronic components used in PCB layout design software.
3.d. Place, route and generate the layout of given circuit using manual or auto routing using PCB layout design software.
3.e. Preview PCB using Layout Design Files.

topics: 4.1. PCB fabrication techniques. PCB fabrication steps of chosen technique.
4.2. PCB Assembly Techniques.
4.3. PCB Testing techniques.
4.4. Steps involved in manual PCB testing.
4.5. Components of Electronic Waste.

uos: 4.a. Study Different PCB Manufacturing techniques.
4.b. Drawing and printing layout on board, photo etching process, masking process, etc.
4.c. Solder components on PCB.
4.d. Study Different PCB testing techniques.
4.e. Follow the PCB testing steps.

4.g. Explain the steps of recycling process of electrical and Electronic waste.
